name: io.github.tagpilot/gtm-mcp
title: Tag Pilot GTM
description: Free, read-only Google Tag Manager: containers, tags, diffs vs live, audits. No GCP setup.

environmentVariables.name: TAGPILOT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Leave unset: the first question connects this device to your free Tag Pilot account in the browser. Set a gtm:mcp key (tpk_…) only for CI or headless setups.

environmentVariables.name: GTM_MCP_NO_BROWSER
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to only return the Google sign-in link (open it in any browser) instead of opening a browser.

environmentVariables.name: GTM_MCP_AUTH_WAIT_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: How long a tool call waits for the browser sign-in before returning the link.
